Finally, the experiment on multi-thread parallel CNC system is carried out which indicates that the system framework is workable, buffer control algorithms is effective.

articleTitle: Design of Parallel AD Acquisition Board Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: From the point of view of system development, this paper introduces a FPGA based parallel AD acquisition board and its implementation process. The board uses 24-bit 8 channels of TI to synchronize the sampling chip ADS1278 to synchronize the input signals of the 8 input signals. FPGA uses Altera's EP2AGX45F572, Nios II processor running on it as the core of data processing. Communication between CY7C68013 and PC can be done with USB Cypress chip. The full use of the Nios can be customized to make the board with the traditional microcontroller or DSP can't achieve the integration of high, strong flexibility and so on. The driver and PC application program are written in VPP, which can store and display the collected data.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the University Ordering System Based on WeChat Platform
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Because the phenomenon about unreasonable arrangement of college students' class hour is relatively common, the system designed a public colleges and universities ordering system based on WeChat. This system took use of convenience and openness of WeChat, which can tremendously simplify the development and promotion. At the same time, online ordering for the students provided a convenient way of eating, and it was conducive to enhance learning efficiency of students. This system mainly completed the users' ordering function. The users can observe the dynamic change in their orders. The sellers can have a real-time observation of the buyers' orders and deal with them in time. And at the same time, sellers can modify their own restaurants information including dishes' information. And the administrator can manage the sellers, including the crud of sellers.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Transform and Neural Network in Near Infrared Spectroscopy Analysis in Pork
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In the present study, an innovative method is proposed, employing both wavelet transform and neural network, to analyze the near-infrared spectrum data in pork. The method entails using db3 wavelet at 5 levels decomposition to process original spectral data, using the transformed data as the input matrix, and creating the model through neural network. The PLS model and ANN model are established by using the original spectral data respectively, and the neural network model is established by using the wavelet feature data. In contrast to the third models can be seen wavelet neural network modeling is the best, and the root-mean-square error of prediction (RMSEP) of moisture, fat and protein reached 0.1808%, 0.1087%, 0.2953%, and correlation coefficient (R) of the moisture, fat, protein were 0.9863, 0.9945, 0.9593. The results show that the wavelet neural network method provides a new method for the detection of moisture, fat, protein and high precision in pork.

articleTitle: Intelligent Hardware Somatosensory Design
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Intelligent hardware will drive people into smart life, becoming the new innovative direction of Internet. However, user acceptance levels of intelligent products are not high in the market, because these products lack relevance and have large distances from industrialization. This paper studies somatosensory interaction modalities of intelligent hardware, aims to improve user acceptance of intelligent hardware. By observing common behaviors of 12 designers in the design process, summary the basic process of somatosensory interactive prototyping. By designing a smart music player, find related factors that influence the performance of somatosensory interaction of intelligent hardware. Experiment is for evaluating usability of the intelligent hardware in order to improve future products. The results of this paper summarize the somatosensory interactive features and design principles of intelligent hardware, and provide theoretical and practical foundation for intelligent hardware development.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Intelligent LED Light Based on Mobile APP
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on people's pursuit of more comfortable and more convenient indoor lighting environment, the system designs and implements a dimming solution, which includes the Android and iOS applications as the mobile terminals, BLE for communication, STM8 processor for control and timing, and Buck circuit for driving light. The self-developed control system has been tested and verified, and the test results show that the solution can be applicable to most mainstream Android and iOS phone operating system, BLE connection is fast, stable and reliable, and light is energy-saving and has precise timing. The solution can meet the domestic demand for comfortable indoor lighting.

articleTitle: Research on Android Vulnerability Mining Technology Based on Control Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Android is widely used in mobile terminals and has serious safety problems. It is important to improve the mobile safety and protect users' privacy, so people need to find the vulnerabilities of Android system and fix them. This paper summarizes the widely-used Android vulnerability mining technologies and writes scripts using Coccinelle tool. In this way, we can find the inappropriate usage of pointer in multiple Android Version.

articleTitle: Chaos Based Blood Glucose Noninvasive Measurement: Concept, Principle and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Understanding deeply the chaotic measurement, we propose firstly a new concept of chaotic sensor on blood glucose (BG) noninvasive test. The problem of BG test in Medical field is in essence, the measurement of micro impedance and phase shifts of the human body tissues in the field of Electricity. To catch the theoretical characteristics of sensitive dependence on initial conditions and spread spectrum, this chaotic sensor built up of Boolean chaotic generator /coder and decoder in XOR gate-based architecture probing our BG RC net model. To combine the micro impedance / phase shift of diabetic patient versus healthy subject and the phase test of Lissajous figure, we select RC parameters. The BG simulated values at two sites of wrist and ankle at right side are shown by scanning the capacitor C. Comparing with Auricular Point's NIRS based tested values versus Bayer BG tested data, the new model can capture better degrees of linearity for BG noninvasive measurement by chaos.

articleTitle: An Anti-noise Speech Recognition Model Based on Improved Wiener Filter and PUM
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The noise resistance is the key in the study of speech recognition technology, this paper proposed an improved Wiener filter combining with the new model of PUM. The model by using the modified Wiener filter to filter out of broadband noise, provides the PUM only partial band noise pollution of speech signal, makes up for the PUM does not apply to speech signal frequency band to be noise pollution. At the same time, the model using the PUM as post-processing of speech enhancement, speech distortion caused by effectively eliminating the speech enhancement. The experimental results show that the modified Wiener filter combining PUM new model under the condition of different noise than other models have better voice recognition rate, can improve the word speech recognition rate of nearly 15%.

articleTitle: A Micro-Vascular Image Segmentation Method Based on the Improved Adaptive Region Growing
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Due to the characteristic of the blood flow in capillaries, the color distribution of the Micro-vascular image is uneven and its gray scale continuity is poor. At the same time, Micro-vascular image also has the characteristic that light color, low contrast with background and so on. Therefore we put forward a Micro-vascular image segmentation method based on the improved adaptive region growing. Firstly this method uses homomorphic filter to adjust the brightness of the image, enhance the visibility of the micro-vascular and the background, and make it clearer. Then use the average gray level of local area and the local average gradient instead of global average gray level and gradient. Thus, we got the adaptive region growing algorithm which improved by the traditional region growing method. Finally we based on the selected seed to split the capillaries. This algorithm is mainly on the characteristics of the capillary images, therefore, compared with other traditional image processing algorithm has better segmentation effect.

articleTitle: Development of Temperature and Humidity Acquisition Graphic User Interface
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Temperature and humidity play important role in many industrial fields. To examine the relationship between these two parameters, a PC program was developed with the help of LabVIEW to acquire both temperature and humidity variations in real time. To reduce the system cost, a simple data acquisition card was employed in the aspect of hardware design. The developed program has a user-friendly interface and it is easy to manipulate.

articleTitle: Narrow-Band Waveform Design in Cooperative Spectrum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to use the idle spectrum effectively and improve the spectrum efficiency, cognitive radio technology has attracted extensive attention. On account of low detection probability and low spectrum efficiency of previous spectrum sensing framework, a relay-based cooperative spectrum sensing framework is proposed and multiple narrow-band waveforms are required for different users which could be separated easily in the fractional Fourier transform domain. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a narrow-band waveform design method, and considering the energy concentration property of chirp signals in fractional Fourier transform domain, we adopt chirp signal as basic function to design narrow-band waveforms and CVX toolbox is used to solve the problem. Simulation results show that the de-signed two waveforms can be separated effectively and hence the detection probability of the cognitive framework could be increased. Moreover, the designed waveforms have relatively high power efficiency so that the transmission performance of cognitive users can be improved as well.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Based on Electromagnetic Particle Swarm Optimization Clustering for Rotating Machine
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Fault diagnosis is an important procedure to ensure the equipment efficiency and stability. The diagnosis process is actually a pattern recognition process, and usually, the fault samples are lack of tags of fault types. In this case, the non-supervised learning method is more available, and kernel clustering is one of the most effective methods. In this paper, a novel electromagnetic particle swarm optimization clustering (EPSOC) was proposed. The weighted kernel clustering model was established by weighting the samples according to the effect of different characters. The clustering center, character weight and the model parameter were united as the optimal variable, and the Xie-Beni index was utilized as the objective function. To find the clustering center and model parameters effectively, the electromagnetism-like operator was introduce into the particle swarm optimization algorithm, and the modified mixing algorithm was utilized. The UCI data and fault samples were used to test the performance of the proposed method EPSOC, and comparing with the other common algorithms, the superiority of EPSOC was demonstrated.

articleTitle: An Improved LDPC-based SEC Error Reconciliation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: CV-QKD has drawn many attentions due to the potential to provide high secret key rate and low cost. Error reconciliation is the key module of post processing of a CV-QKD system. In this paper, an improved LDPC-based SEC error reconciliation scheme is proposed. Through the optimization of inner-level decoding and reduction of the iteration rounds of inter-level decoding, the reconciliation can be accelerated evidently. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can improve the reconciliation rate to 16.55kbps with the reconciliation efficiency of 91.8% when SNR is 4.5dB.

articleTitle: Study of Fuzzy PID Control System for the Product Oil Pipe-Convey
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Oil is one of the most important energy sources in the world, due to the uneven distribution of it, its transportation is an important step in the process of oil production. With the development of information technology, the traditional way of pipeline transportation has been unable to meet the requirement of high speed and high accuracy of product oil transportation process. A fuzzy PID control system in the product oil pipe-convey is designed in this paper, industrial control computer, programmable logic controller and KingView are used in the system for monitoring the oil transportation process on the computer. For the hysteresis character of pipeline pressure and oil flow rate, fuzzy PID is used in the system for reducing overshoot and improving control accuracy. Combined with programmable logic controller, KingView configuration software and fuzzy PID algorithm, the system has the advantages of easy operation, high reliability and easy upgrade. After put the system into production, the result shows that: the system has high reliability and high control accuracy, it can meet the requirements of the transmission of product oil.

articleTitle: Iterative Side-Channel Cube Attack on KeeLoq
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: KeeLoq is a 528-round lightweight block cipher which has a 64-bit secret key and a 32-bit block length. The cube attack, proposed by Dinur and Shamir, is a new type of attacking method. In this paper, we investigate the security of KeeLoq against iterative side-channel cube attack which is an enhanced attack scheme. Based on structure of typical block ciphers, we give the model of iterative side-channel cube attack. Using the traditional single-bit leakage model, we assume that the attacker can exactly possess the information of one bit leakage after round 23. The new attack model costs a data complexity of 211.00 chosen plaintexts to recover the 23-bit key of KeeLoq. Our attack will reduce the key searching space to 241 by considering an error-free bit from internal states.

articleTitle: Maneuver Detection and Track for HBG Aircraft Based on IMM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The research works on maneuver detection and tracking technology for the hypersonic boost-glide (HBG) aircraft. Firstly, its motion models are presented by the earlier research. Then, a maneuver detection method is proposed applying interactive multi-mode (IMM) algorithm based on the switch time of model probability for the hypersonic target. Finally the effective and continuous tracking is realized for the HBG aircraft based on space-based platform, employing interactive multi-mode with unscented Kalman filter (IMM-UKF) algorithm for nonlinear filtering. The results show that the models are accurate and the IMM-UKF algorithm is valid.

articleTitle: A Detection Method of Fuel Spray Distribution Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Automotive fuel injector is the key part of automobile engine, and its spray characteristics are an important indicator to measure its performance. Fuel spray distribution is one of the important parameters of spray characteristics. This paper studies an effective detection method of spray distributions, which measured height of fuel collected by distributor by image detection method based on optical density, and then converting to the distribution of fuel mass. This method replaced the original manual weighing methods for improved accuracy and speed, and it reduced the errors effectively. By analyzing the fuel spray distributions under different coordinate axis, we can get the parameters which described the geometric characteristic of spray, such as the center of mass of spray, the angular extent of the spray cone and the direction of the spray cone relative to the injector axis. The detection of spray characteristics is the guarantee of maximum the quality of fuel combustion.

articleTitle: Double Power Nonsingular Sliding Mode Guidance Law Based on Super-Twisting Disturbance Observer
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Considering the terminal impact constraint problem, a novel sliding mode guidance law with no chatting is proposed to intercept high-speed maneuvering target. First, the super-twisting disturbance observer is designed to estimate the unknown target acceleration with a small observation error. Then, based on double power reaching law, a nonsingular terminal sliding mode guidance law is proposed, avoiding the singular problem of the traditional terminal sliding surface. Compared to the guidance law based on exponential reaching law, the proposed guidance law can guarantee the line-of-sight (LOS) angle converge to desired value rapidly in finite time, as well as a smaller miss distance. Numerical simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed guidance law.

articleTitle: Modified Sliding Correlate Algorithm of Beidou B1 Signal
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The intermediate-frequency signal changes from BeiDou signal can get original signal of acquisition and tracking after analog to digital conversion. Sliding correlate algorithms, matched filter algorithm and circular convolution algorithm based on FFT are three of the most widely used acquisition algorithm at present. This article introduce the three algorithm and analyze their advantages and disadvantages. Among them, sliding correlate algorithm has simple structure and it's easy to achieve. But it takes more time to capture BeiDou B1 signal. Modified sliding correlation algorithm is presented base on the analysis of the structure of BeiDou B1 signal and traditional sliding correlation algorithm. New algorithm has simple structure as well. The speed of acquisition is increased. Simulation of modified sliding correlate algorithm indicate the speed of modified algorithm is more ideal.

articleTitle: Second Hamming Code Used in Radiation Hardened Communication Environment
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The event upset is the main concern of reliability in space communication. Among all event upset tolerant techniques, error detecting and correcting coding technique is simple and effective to protect the communication of micro-processor between the memory and register. This paper propose a second hamming code technique which can improve the error detecting and error correcting capacity based on minimum Hamming distance. Therefore, this second hamming code technique can be used in radiation hardened communication environment. Experiment results have also proved that second hamming code is complexity and is effective to error detecting and correcting.

articleTitle: Method of Improving the Resource Utilization Based on Signal Extrapolation in Wireless Communication System
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, the task of using the limited wireless resources to meet diverse applications of different qualities of service requirements is performed by presenting a method of improving the resource utilization based on the theory of discrete-time band-limited signal extrapolation. The feasibility of the proposed method is theoretically explained and effectively demonstrated by means of simulation. The proposed method is verified to have an important value for further research.

articleTitle: Research on a Data Access Control Model Based on Region
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For traditional RBAC access control model is not a good solution for user access control in different regions, this paper analysis and research on the traditional model, we propose a control model RBAC-RB based on different areas of authority. According to this model, which realize the access control that users in different regions of the data-level permissions. And the model successfully used in smart city system permissions control development, project proven the correctness and reliability of the model.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Model of Gene Regulation with Reference to Multisource Biological Information
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Generally, well-constructed gene regulatory models can serve as a blueprint for researchers to understand the complex regulatory relationships among genes. Since the traditional models and methods for network construction are with low accuracy, and do not reveal detailed mechanisms among in-cell substances related to gene regulation, we present here a new dynamic model of gene regulation with reference to multisource biological information. The effectivity of our proposed method is verified by applying it to a collection of genes in the yeast genome. The experimental result shows that our model is capable to discover new interaction related to gene regulation.

articleTitle: Development of a Testing System for Springs Used in Brake Valves for Trains
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Brake valve springs, such as 104 and F8 valve springs, are essential components in a braking system of a passenger train. Their maintenance quality has a direct impact on the vehicle operation security. In this paper, a new kind of testing system was developed for springs used in brake valves. This system overcame several shortcomings of existing ones and could meet the requirements of new standard. Firstly, technical specifications and overall design of this system were put forward on the basis of current passenger train maintenance standard. Secondly, its control system consisting of a microcontroller and a CPLD chip as the master controller, as well as its peripheral hardware circuit were designed. Then, a stepper motor is used to achieve accurate measurement of the spring parameters, including free height, assembly load and work load. After that, a computer software was coded by using VC++ platform. Finally, the relationship between the force loaded onto the weighting sensor and its corresponding deformation was obtained. Based on this relationship, the error caused by the deformation during the load measurement was compensated, and the performance specifications of the testing system were also verified.

articleTitle: A New Type MySQL Integrated Mutual Authentication Security Model
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: MySQL database identity authentication uses a CHAP protocol, that is, the challenge/response protocol, which exists the password expressly transmission, one-way authentication, random time can not grasp and other security issues. In this paper, we analyze the security problems of the existing MySQL database authentication protocol, and propose a new type MySQL integrated mutual authentication security model. The model integrates the two-way authentication in MySQL, which realizes mutual authentication between database and user, It provides an interface for the session key, which improves the security of the data operation in the MySQL database, At the same time joining the random number in the authentication process, which can effectively resist replay attacks, etc. At the end of this paper, cases analysis of the new security model. The results show that the proposed security authentication model can ensure the security of user information and data transmission.

articleTitle: Metrology of S11 Phase
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: According to the transmission line theory, we proposed the metrology method of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> phase parameter. The theoretical method has been proved based on the experiments of standard mismatches, Open kit, short kit, air lines and other device. The experiment also find out the law of error distribution, which is that the error's absolute value has negative relationship with the magnitude of reflection coefficient, and the error distribution between opens and short kits is basically symmetrical. Therefore, a 'Residual transmission line' model is proposed which based on mismatches, and the rationality of the model has beenverified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Electric Motorcycle Control System Based on GPS and CAN Technology
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: CAN bus technology is currently one of the hottest technology in today's automation, is a very important part in industrial automation field, In this paper the design of electric motorcycle control system is based on CAN bus and GPS technology, CAN bus as a primary means of communication between the master control center and each control node, combined with GPS / GPRS technology, through monitoring and controlling the overall system, realizing the function of monitoring the electric motorcycle system state, anti-theft and tracking, Experiment showed that, communication of CAN network nodes is stable, reliable and real-time and stolen motorcycle also can be located accurately, which verifies the reliability and safety of electric motorcycle control systems and this system has a wide range of practical applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Functional Mechanism of the Interference Magnetic Field on Straight Light Path Type Optical Current Transformers
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The straight light path type OCTs feature simple optical paths and high reliability, but are vulnerable to interference from the external magnetic field. In this paper, the method of Jones matrix is adopted to establish the sensing models of the straight light path type OCTs for analyzing their sensing characteristics and thus revealing the functional mechanism of the interference magnetic field. It is found from the analysis that the interference magnetic field works either by changing the sensing coefficient of the straight light path type OCT or by changing the target magnetic field, moreover, the analysis also shows that the impact of the interference magnetic field on the sensing coefficient can be neglected, but the impact is significantly seen on the target magnetic field, which thus can significantly reduce the measurement accuracy of the straight light path type OCTs. The simulation results show that, under the action of 1000A interference current, the measurement error of the straight light path type OCTs is 2.91%, which is far beyond the accuracy level limit of 0.2, so the simulation results coincide with the theoretical analysis. The research in this paper can lay the theoretical basis for analyzing and optimizing the magnetic resistance characteristics of the straight light path type OCTs.

articleTitle: Corona Current Data Acquisition Card Based on USB Bus in Extra High Voltage Environment
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper introduces a corona current data acquisition card based on USB. According to the characteristics of the corona current, the hardware circuit of USB acquisition card includes signal conditioning circuit, data acquisition circuit and peripheral circuit, and the program needed for the device including PC driver and application program were designed. In order to verify the function of the corona current measurement system, the performance test and the field test of the USB acquisition card are carried out. The test prove the data integrity of the data acquisition card and the accuracy of the data acquisition. It shows that the acquisition card is steadily, accurate, and can meet the requirements of the index.

articleTitle: HIRFL Water Level Monitoring System Research and Design
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: HIRFL system is the most advanced all-around heavy ion research facility. It is responsible for many of the scientific tasks in China, so to ensure its safe operation is a major responsibility by the Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Science. There are many magnets and power needs water to cool, so the water system plays an important role in the whole HIRFL system. We design a set of water level monitoring system in order to protect the normal operation of the water system in this paper. It can monitoring tank level situation real-time, and visually displayed on a control room interface for water supply system of HIRFL. All of the design theory, and specific hardware and software design, and the specific operating results were given by this paper.

articleTitle: An Efficient Content-Based Event Matching Algorithm Based on Double-Deck Tree Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: A novel algorithm for event matching of publish /subscribe systems is presented. To use the filtering abilities of attribute names and values synthetically, a double-deck tree structure is proposed. For the first deck, the proposed algorithm builds a tree structure by using the attribute names. All subscriptions are partitioned into the nodes of the first deck tree according to the attribute contained in their constraints. For the second deck, the other tree structure is constructed for each leaf node of the first deck tree based on the attribute values. The subscriptions stored in each node of the first deck tree are also classified in order to be stored in the nodes of the second deck tree. When an event is being processed, the number of the possible matched subscriptions can be cut down by using the attribute values as the criterion. Experimental results show that the algorithm can shorten the matching time and improve efficiency of the event matching.

articleTitle: Repeating Decoys Discrimination Based on Range Glint
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Repeating decoys (based on DRFM), through the main lobe into the radar receiver, realistically simulate real target's echo in both time and frequency domain, and cause serious threat to radar's search, identification and tracking. At the near distance, angular error caused by target's angular glint is an important noise source and it can be utilized to the discrimination of repeating decoys. At the remote and ultra long distance, angular glint is not applicable for the discrimination of repeating decoys. Compared with the angular glint error, the range glint error is completely independent of the target's absolute distance. Therefore, the target's range glint provides a basis to the discrimination between the repeating decoy and the actual target. This paper, based on the premise that the actual target is multi-feed radiation and the repeating decoy is single feed radiation, analyzes the range glint of extended targets by sampling ratio ranging model and explains its physical essence from the perspective of echo spectrum distortion. On the basis, by analyzing the range measuring variance of both actual targets and repeating decoys, the Neyman-Pearson theorem and GLRT are utilized to make correct discrimination. Finally, the performance of the discrimination algorithm is illustrated by Monte Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Star Image Noise Filtering Based on Diffusion Model of Regularization Influence Function
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: As the noise filtering of star map is special, noise filtering needs to remain the details on the edge of star in the basic phase of identifying stars. The author proposes a method of star image noise filtering based on diffusion model of regularization influence function by using Tukey diffusion model and improved PM model. This method can extract boundary point sets by derivative operator, do noise filtering according to space distribution characteristics of original pixel and noise pixel, and fulfill the goal of restoring the edge by boundary conditions given. In the simulation experiment of ordinary image and star map, this method is used to show better capability of noise filtering and remain the edge of feature image effectively. Compared to ordinary diffusion function algorithm, this algorithm is lower by 13.6% in the aspect of mean absolute error, higher by 6.1% on Peak Signal to Noise Ratio. These statistics can illustrate that this method is better than ordinary diffusion function method in terms of filtering ability, which more applies to do noise filtering of star map.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Carrier Tracking Performance for BeiDou Signals in Presence of Ionospheric Scintillation
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Ionospheric scintillation can cause rapid change in the phase and amplitude of BeiDou system (BDS) navigation signals, resulting in degraded accuracy and robustness of signal tracking loops. Compared with the frequency lock loop and delay lock loop, phase lock loop (PLL) is much weaker, and would lose lock much more continually in scintillation. We analyze the variance of PLL for BDS carrier tracking under different scintillation conditions. On the basis of simulation of BDS scintillation signal, we evaluate the carrier tracking performance with different loop order, loop discriminator and loop bandwidth by comparing the phase jitter and probability of loss-of-lock. Finally, we propose the PLI-based bandwidth adaptive carrier tracking algorithm to improve the accuracy and robustness of PLL. Numerical results show that the proposed algorithm has a balanced performance under different scintillation conditions, which can provide helpful reference for the future design of BDS receiver.

articleTitle: Non-repudiation Scheme of Smart Home Based on Cloud Service
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Smart home control model based on cloud service not only solves the problem that different equipment manufactures carry out diversified long-range control model, but also provides key technology for gang control of multiple devices. However, the operation controversy among user, cloud provider and equipment can't be ignored. To solve the operation repudiation of participators, an ID-based non-repudiation scheme is presented. The security analysis shows that the presented scheme which involves signature, signature verification, feedback signature, feedback signature verification and execution instruction solves the possibly controversial problem in process of smart home control, and improves the security of based on cloud service smart home system.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Pre-processing System for Mobile Core Network Measurement
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the rapid increasing number of mobile devices being used as essential terminals or platforms for communication, security threats now target the whole telecommunication infrastructure. However, most of the software-based passive measurement system (PMS) could not achieve high performance to adapt the high-bandwidth mobile network. In this paper, we propose NTW, a real-time pre-processing system deploys between high-speed mobile core network and PMS to accomplish the large and repetitive work, such as decapsulation, decompression and PPP character unescape before the PMS receives the traffic flow. We evaluated the performance and accuracy of our NTW over a wide-area real network. Evaluation results indicate that NTW can achieve more than 15Gbps.

articleTitle: A New Estimate Method of a Soft-Fault Parameter Value in Self-Healing Circuits Part II: Two Examples and a Programming Strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Two examples and a programming strategy are used to further illustrate the principles of the new estimate method introduced in part I of the paper. In two examples, soft-faults of some elements are simulated, and steady-state node-voltage vectors (SSNVVs) are measured. Then the new estimate method is carried out. Results show the proposed method would effectively improve estimate process of a soft-fault parameter value (SFPV) in a linear time-invariant circuit network.

articleTitle: Multi-step Identification Algorithm for the Multi-sensor System with Unknown Parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: For the multi-sensor system with unknown observation noises and parameters, based on ARMA model, a multi-step algorithm is presented. The first step is to use recursive instrumental variable method and the method of average local model parameter estimations to get the initial fusion estimations. The second step is to get the estimations of the observation noises variance by system identification method. The third step is to take the reciprocal of the estimations of the sensor's observation noise variance obtained in the second step as the weight, use weighted recursive instrumental variable method to get the final local estimations of the parameters, use the method of average local model parameter estimations to get the final estimations. The final fusion estimations have better convergence than the initial fusion estimations. The convergence of the estimations of the parameters and noise variance are proved. This algorithm could be used to get a kind of self-tuning Kalman filter. An example shows the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: An Implement of Actor Model - uJavaActor's Improvement
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: To solve the complex problems of Multi-Thread programing, a frame of the model of Java Actor used to implement uJavaActor is discussed. The startup speed, responding speed in long time running, and the average running time of the system are accelerated by the improvements of Thread pool, Java lock and concurrent data structure in uJavaActor frame. The uJavaActor improved is compared in runtime contrast with the original frame in the area about the running speed of implementing the model of MapReduce. After analyzing the running results, the frame improved consists of higher startup speed, shorter running time, and faster reaction after receiving new tasks, which proves that the total running speed of the uJavaActor model is boosted efficaciously with the improvements in such two areas.

articleTitle: Analysis of Operational Performance Reliability for CNC Equipment
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Operational reliability evaluation for CNC equipment, which is the key equipment in modern production line, is very important. Here, the hidden semi-Markov model (HSMM) is adopted to evaluate and predict the operational reliability of CNC equipment based on the performance parameter datasets. The field data from a CNC milling machine center is used to train and validate the model. It is shown that incorporating the explicit state duration model significantly improves the results compared to hidden Markov model (HMM).

articleTitle: Wideband Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio with Double-Level Binary Tree Bayesian Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Based on the fact that the spectrum in cognitive radio system is typically sparse, a novel wideband spectrum sensing algorithm is proposed taking advantage of Bayesian compressed sensing. Under our proposed scheme, the signal of interest can be sampled at sub-Nyquist rate so relaxing the sampling tension of front-end hardware. Furthermore, the block structure of the spectrum molded by a set of double-level binary tree is also exploited in the spectrum sensing process so promoting the spectrum sensing accuracy with lower sampling rate. Taking the MCMC sampling method as efficient inference, experimental results show the validity of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and Key Technology of MES for Spacecraft Assembly
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, aimed at the assembly business of spacecrafts such as satellites and airships, the author has analyzed the the new demands in the management of spacecraft assembly, including the change of design and manufacturing mode and the optimization of workflow, put forward the overall framework and core function module design for MES of spacecraft assembly, and provided ideas and methods on the key technical issues in the system implementation.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Military Chess Pieces Discrimination Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to popularize the dark military chess, this paper presented a method using image processing to identify military chess pieces and determine their grade size. First, the method of scanning row and column was used to extract the image of chess pieces from original image. Two chess pieces images were separated with the method of row and column scanning, too. Next, the size of R component in two chess pieces images were calculated to determine the color of two chessmen images and the information which one is black or red was obtained. Then, two chess pieces images were processed with gray and binarization respectively, and the size of two chess pieces images were normalized. At the last, two chess pieces pictures were matched with the templates in corresponding templates library that created in advance. The chinese character of chess pieces can be identified. After two chess pieces images were recognized, and the grade size of two chess pieces were determined according to the rules of military chess. Experimental results show that the proposed method has a high recognition rate which is 100% and fast processing speed which is up to 0.730594s.

articleTitle: DPSK Signal Carrier Synchronization Module Implemented on the FPGA
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to implement the modified square loop digitally on the FPGA to solve the problem, that the divide circuit in the traditional square loop is difficult to achieve. The modified square loop has a similar structure to the traditional square loop. The method of modified square loop is to multiply quadrature output together to replace the divide circuit. In this paper, a specific method is given to digitize the square loop. The output carrier signal and the frequency difference will be analyzed in the condition of different initial frequency offset, parameters of the loop filter and input SNR.

articleTitle: Spectrum Analysis of Anode Rod Current in Aluminum Reduction Cell Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The signal acquisition system was designed, and the voltage drop of the anode rod of three anodes in the same cell was measured. After the data is processed, the current signal of anode in aluminum electrolysis process is analyzed by wavelet transform. The main frequency range of the anode current in different position is found by the spectrum analysis of the third layer detail signals and the approximation signals. The results show that the spectrum of the three anodes' current is roughly similar, but the position of the main frequency changed. The paper discussed the relation of these spectrums with the physical and chemical behaviors of the electrolysis cell.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Crosstalk Characteristics of Straight Light Path Type Optical Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The straight light path type optical current transformer is exposed to the magnetic field interference in the three-phase power system. In this paper the mathematical model of magnetic interference rate (MIR) of straight light path type optical current transformer was established, and the MIR characters of straight light path type optical current transformer were researched. The research showed that the structural parameters of straight light path type optical current transformer are the key factors influencing the MFI of straight light path type optical current transformer, and the study discovered that the MIR of straight light path type optical current transformer decreases with the decreasing length of the magneto-optic crystal or distance between the magneto-optical and the current to be measured. Basing on that, an optimization method was proposed to improve the anti-interference ability of straight light path type optical current transformer by reducing the distance between the magneto-optic crystal and the current to be measured. The experimental results showed that the error of straight light path type optical current transformer induced by magnetic crosstalk decreased by at least one order of magnitude when the distance between the magneto-optical and the current to be measured reduced from 20cm to 4.4cm. The experimental results are consistent with the theoretical analysis conclusions, and that demonstrates the correctness and practicality of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Quasi-Cyclic Low-Density Parity-Check Codes Based on Progressive Cycle Growth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Short cycles in the Tanner graph of a given LDPC code has negative effect on the performance of iterative decoding. To improve the performance, we presented an approach for constructing Quasi-Cyclic Low-Density Parity-Check (QC-LDPC) codes whose associated Tanner graph has large girth and a small amount of short cycles. Each column block of the parity check matrix was designed by adding circulant permutation sub-matrices one after another, provided the current parity check matrix has minimal number of short cycles. The condition for the proposed QC-LDPC codes to have girth at least 6 was also analyzed. Regular and irregular QC-LDPC codes with various lengths and rates can be constructed. Simulations show that the proposed QC-LDPC codes have less short cycles and better performance than existing progressive edge growth based QC-LDPC codes.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Space Manipulator Based on Lie Group
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The problem of modeling based on Lie group is studied for space manipulator system with characteristics of nonlinear and strong coupling. By introducing the corresponding relation between rigid body motion and SE(3) and the exponential product method, a recursive model and its matrix representation based on Lie group is obtained through forward and backward recursive process, which has advantages of less calculation amount, unified form of models and definite physical meaning. Comparing the simulation result under the same condition between Lie group model and classical model, a high similarity was presented, proving the validity of Lie group method.

articleTitle: Research on Fusion Method of Prior Information in Maintainability Test
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low precision of prior information fusion caused by different data population in maintainability test, the conversion model of prior information was proposed based on the availability of information, the problem of unable to fuse the information because of different data population was solved. The parameters of prior distribution were fitted by random weighting method, prior distribution was described exactly. Weight determination method based on the degree of support was proposed, and the reasonability of weighting fusion was improved. Finally, the engineering application value of the fusion method proposed by this thesis was proved by the information fusion instance of a certain equipment in maintainability test.

articleTitle: Study on Invulnerability of the Internet Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the invulnerability of the router level Internet topology based on MapReduce framework. Two new measures are proposed to evaluate the network invulnerability: connectivity ratio and efficiency ratio. We design and implement an algorithm to analysis the Internet invulnerability based on MapReduce (AIIMR). In this algorithm, different attack strategies are used to simulate the network attack. The results of the experiment on different networks show that the router level Internet has strong invulnerability at random attack, but is extremely fragile at targeted attack.

articleTitle: Ship Detection and Recognition Based on Multi-physical Fields
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The detection and identification of the kinds of ships, i.e., warship or merchant ship, is of great interest for military use. Ships are usually detected and recognized based on ship physical fields, and the commonly used ship physical fields include sound field, magnetic field, hydraulic pressure field, electric field, gravity field, etc, which all contain plenty of discriminative information. However, the existing ship identification methods are usually based on single ship physical field, which will limit the model performance. In this work, we proposed a ship recognition method based on combination of multi-physical fields, i.e., sound field and magnetic field. To the best of the authors' knowledge, this is the first work to recognize ships based on multi-physical fields. We fuse features extracted from multi-physical fields by Principal Component Analysis (PCA), which is then fed to Support Vector Machine (SVM) to realize the recognition of ship. Plenty of experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: United Estimation of Weibull Distribution Parameters Based on Modified ABC
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Reliability analysis is quite important in the facility failure and equipment life studies, and the Weibull distribution is the most common model in the reliability analysis. Therefore, the effective identification of the Weibull model parameters of the facilities has significant importance in the reliability analysis. In this paper, a united estimation method combining probability weighted moments and maximum likelihood estimation is proposed, and the estimation model of Weibull distribution parameters is established. The modified artificial bee colony algorithm introducing Chaos intelligent search strategy and differential evolution operator is used for the estimation model solution. The analysis result shows that MABC has better optimization capability, and the proposed method has the advantages of high precision and strong stability.

articleTitle: An Improved DP Compression Algorithm of Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Because there are the following problems in the wireless sensor network: the collected data redundancy degree is higher, the node energy is limited, and the node storage is limited and so on, this paper puts forward an improved DP data compression algorithm, that is, the collected data is transmitted after they are firstly compressed. Adopt the method of automatically setting the compression threshold value to reduce the influence of personal factor on the compression process, use the best curve fitting algorithm to fit the curve to reduce the random error and increase the compression precision, use the step length and stack technologies to decrease the frequency of scanning of data point and reduce the energy consumption of node. The simulation result indicates that the improved DP compression algorithm is batter than the DP compression algorithm in the aspects of compression precision and the energy consumption of node, and therefore, it is more suitable for the wireless sensor network whose energy and storage are limited.

articleTitle: Application Constraints of the Three-Axis Stabilization Magnetic Control Method Based on LQR
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Taking KT-1A satellite in practical flight as the research object, this paper adopts LOR infinite horizon periodic controller to perform the three-axis stabilized attitude control, and the magnetorquer is taken as the only actuator. It specially studies the application constraints produced by different assumptions in the mathematical model which may not be met in actual projects, including that the inertia matrix is diagonal, orbit eccentricity is zero, magnetic field varies periodically, the orbit inclination is near 90°, etc. Through analysis and simulations, the critical conditions that may cause serious consequences are identified.

articleTitle: Design of Multidimensional Space Motion Simulation System for Spacecraft Attitude and Orbit Guidance and Control Based on Radar RF Environment
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation system of spacecraft attitude and orbit control has been studied. In this paper, the composing of the HIL system and the main functions of sub-systems are given. The method to determine the scaling ratio of a simulation system is introduced. A novel communication scheme is designed based on optical reflective fiber memory. The details to design a GNC/dynamic simulator including their working flow is developed. Finally, the ground monitor sub-system is discussed. The design and develop of HIL simulation system provides a basic platform for ground HIL simulation of spacecraft.

articleTitle: Shaft Vibration Monitoring System for Rotating Machinery
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Monitoring of rotating machinery plays an essential role in industry. The basic software and hardware structure of the shaft vibration monitoring system of rotating machinery is introduced in this paper. The vibration signals caused by different reasons were analyzed. The national standard is based on vibration vibration velocity amplitude as the evaluation standard, but can not determine what is the cause of the abnormal vibration. By experiment we made analysis method of acceleration frequency or acceleration envelope frequency, amplitude and frequency setting monitoring, to determine the cause of the abnormal vibration of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: Grid-Refinement Direction of Arrival Tracking via Least Square Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel DOA tracking algorithm based on Least Square Compressive Sensing. The algorithm comes from the observation that a compressive sensing problem turns into a least square problem once the support is known. Utilizing the support from former time instant, compressive sensing recovery is performed on residual when least square residual is bigger than a threshold. In order to improve the resolution and decrease computation complexity, grid refinement is performed before least square. Under the assumption that the sparsity pattern of signal changes slowly, the grid refinement step is sufficient to track the DOA and the compressive sensing recovery step can be omitted in most of the time. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed DOA tracking algorithm possess better performance and requires less computational complexity.

articleTitle: Lifetime Enhancement by Cluster Head Evolutionary Energy Efficient Routing Model for WSN
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new model to efficiently control cluster-heads using heterogeneous sensors in real-time. It also proposes a generic software framework to feasibly and efficiently meet the needs of the users and applications (e.g., reliability, energy efficiency). The proposed model and its method have been implemented and evaluated in Matlab, comparing its performance with known protocols for WSNs. The proposed model is suitable for common use because it is superior to other methods by energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Servo Real-Time Control Network Design of Dynamic Priority Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Compared to conventional control systems, network control system has advantages in lower installation costs and easier maintenance. Regarding computer control, a design for network control system is proposed based on CAN (Controller Area Network). Through optimizing the design of the network adapter, computer centralized control algorithm can be applied to a simple network control. After analyzing the strategies of the network control interface, the real-time characteristics of CAN has been studied. A multi-channel control scheme for CAN is proposed. Then the structure of CAN is designed, which is constituted by CAN card and node controller. Finally, practical performance and high reliability of the system is proved by experiments.

articleTitle: Vibration Fault Identification Based on Coupled EMD and Energy Distribution
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The vibration fault identification is a significant process of the reliability analysis for large rotating machine, and the accuracy of identification results depends on the effectiveness of extracted fault symptoms directly. For the vibration symptoms extraction, the time-frequency domain analysis has been widely utilized. Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) is one of the most typical time-frequency method, but its performance is effected by the mode mixing problem. In this paper, a novel coupled EMD is proposed, and utilized to the vibration signal decomposition. In the CEMD, the differential vibration signal was obtained and decomposed by EMD, and then, the results were integrated and couple decomposed by EMD. After decomposition, the energy distribution vectors were extracted as the fault symptoms. At last, the obtained vibration symptoms were taken as input, and the classifier was utilized to identify the different kinds of faults for the large rotating machine. The proposed method was applied into the actual fault identification for the rolling element bearings, and the results demonstrated that, CEMD can improve the mode mixing problem significantly, while the energy distribution symptoms has the advantages of high universality and strong separability, and the vibration faults can be identified more accurately with higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on Multi-missile Cooperative Attack between the Differential Game and Proportional Navigation Method
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper introduces an approach that involved with multi-missile cooperative attack based on the differential game. By comparing with the traditional proportional navigation method, the differential game shows better performance. Firstly, a mathematical model of multi-missile cooperative attack is established, Secondly, thesis introduces the differential game and proportional navigation method by solving the given problems, Finally, a numerical simulation has been made in Matlab programming environment, which shows that the differential game has more applicability and cooperative tracing ability.

articleTitle: Superpixels Segmentation via Growing Minimum Spanning Trees and Reassigning Boundary Pixels
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Along with the development of high resolution observation system, the spatial resolution of remote sensing images increases greatly. As it comes to the effective intelligent interpretation of high spatial resolution remote data, the traditional way of per-pixel processing is hardly applicable. On the other hand, the Object-Oriented method has shown its necessity and advantage, that is, grouping contiguous image pixels which are in homogeneous regions into segments (what we call superpixels). In this paper, we propose a superpixel algorithm to segment an image by means of generating minimum spanning trees and iteratively reassigning boundary pixels to improve segment accuracy. The proposed approach is compared with a state-of-the-art superpixel algorithm, SLIC [1], in terms of standard metrics, which are boundary recall (BR), under-segmentation error (UE) and achievable segmentation accuracy (ASA).

articleTitle: Fault Injection Strategy Based on FTA Optimized by Fuzzy Gray Relational Degree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem in random fault injection strategy which might lead to failed fault injection, a fault injection strategy based on fuzzy gray relational fault tree analysis is presented. First, fuzzy probability of basic events are determined by normal fuzzy number, so that the fuzzy median of top events and the fuzzy importance of basic events could be figured out. Then, comparison of sequences and reference sequences of gray relational analysis could be determined. Finally, the gray relational degree ranking of the minimal cut sets is taken as the basis of fault injection point selection. Case study shows that this method could not only efficiently solve the fuzzy and gray problems in selecting fault injection points, but also has popularization and application value for its convenience.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Detecting Method of Mechanical Interface Contact Distribution
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Contact analysis of mechanical interface has been an important engineering problem. Based on the interaction principle between ultrasonic wave and imperfect interface, experimental method on contact area and distribution of steel-steel interface with pulse-echo technique is presented in this paper. In the method, ultrasonic echo signal being denoised and transformed with Fourier transform to get amplitude value, two-dimensional characteristic data array is obtained by scanning detection system to describe the interface. After low resolution arrays are registered with Fourier-Mellin transformation and Taylor series algorithm, the scanning detection resolution is improved by POCS(Projection onto convex sets) algorithm with multiple low resolution arrays. The experimental results show that the experimental method to evaluate the interface contact area and distribution is reliable, and has practical value on analysis and research of real contact engineering problems.

articleTitle: The Design of Electronic Current Collector Based on Fault Travelling Wave Location
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: This paper presents a new-type design of electronic current collector based on fault travelling wave location. It increases high-speed signal acquisition circuit to collect fault travelling wave signal. While in order to transmit the data of failure travelling wave to merging unit (MU) for secondary equipment to make a fault distance analysis, it proposes a new communication protocol between the collector of current transformer and MU in this paper. Furthermore, the design has been proved that the new electronic current collector can not only realize the basic acquisition of measurement and protection data, but also can realize the complete acquisition of fault travelling wave signal and achieve effective communication.

articleTitle: A Compensating Method of Gravity Deformation Curve Calculation for the Column of Heavy-Duty Floor-Type Boring and Milling Machine
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: The inhomogeneity of material is assumed to be the reason that affects the accuracy of FEM simulation of gravity deformation curve for the column of heavy-duty floor-type boring and milling machine. To solve this problem, a compensation method of gravity deformation curve calculation is proposed by discretizing the column into segments based on finite difference method. Equivalent flexural rigidity is utilized to characterize the inhomogeneity of the material. The results of FEM simulation is corrected by the proposed equivalent flexural rigidity based on a correction model. The experimental result shows that the computational accuracy is improved from 19.88% to 62.37%, compared with just FEM simulation.

articleTitle: Design of a Novel RFID Microstrip Antenna and HFSS Simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: According to the working principle and the actual correction of the RFID microstrip antenna, this paper designed a new type of rectangular microstrip antenna which worked under the condition of circular polarization, and in this design, the new type of rectangular microstrip antenna is obtained by loading an equal number of rectangular slot in the each broadside of the symmetrical triangle cutting angle antenna. On the basis of triangular symmetrical corner cutting antenna, and by using the Ansoft company's HFSS10.0 software, we modeled and optimized the parameters of the new type of microstrip antenna. The results show that the new microstrip antenna has better reflection coefficient compared with the triangular symmetrical angle cut antenna. And at the same time, the new type of microstrip antenna has better antenna gain and bandwidth.

articleTitle: Implement Duffing Chaotic Theory on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Duffing chaotic theory has character of sensitive dependence on initial conditions and noise immunity. More and more people use it to detect weak signals. However it's staying in the theoretical level and few people implements this theory on the hardware. In this paper, on the base of Duffing chaotic theory, it is verified that the theory can be realized on the hardware system which includes signal generator, ADC chip, FPGA development board, USB2.0 chip and PC.

articleTitle: 3D Image Reconstruction of Monocrystalline Silicon Internal Defects Based on Ultrasonic Detection
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: With the purpose of detecting the internal defects of monocrystalline silicon, an ultrasonic detection platform has been set up with the method of circle traversal detection combining transmission and reflection laws. Marching Cubes algorithm is applied on the 3D image reconstruction of the silicon's internal structure to integrate and marginalize the defect information from different internal sections. Therefore, with this transparent processing method, the depth, size and shape of the internal defect can be acquired effectively, intuitively and accurately. The reconstruction experiments show the relative error of the defect diameter measurement is less than 4% comparing to the real measured value.

articleTitle: Research of Robust Auto-Associative Neural Network and Its Application for Gas Turbine Blade Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper the problem of fault diagnosis for gas turbine blade is investigated, the signal processing technology is used to analyze the principle of gas turbine fault, the no fault model is small deviations, the variation of parameters deviation is isolated, the faults coefficient matrix is used to link the measured parameters deviation and performance deviation, the relative changes of some parameters are extracted. The robust auto-associative neural network is applied to diagnosis the gas turbine faults, we have also presented a comparison between our proposed approach and other commonly used methods known as BP neural networks and auto-associative neural network to demonstrate the advantages and capabilities of our approach. Various simulations are carried out to demonstrate the performance capabilities of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Advantage of the Beidou Navigation System: Application in Emergency Logistics
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: Firstly, characteristics of emergency logistics are introduced based on the definition of emergency logistics. Secondly, information demand of emergency logistics is put forward. Thirdly, GPS navigation system and the Beidou navigation system are compared when they are applied in emergency logistics. The comparison shows that Beidou navigation system has three main advantages than GPS navigation system for emergency logistics. They are security, high reliability and bidirectional communication. Lastly, the future development of Beidou in emergency logistics is prospected.

articleTitle: A Novel Energy Sensing Algorithm of Cognitive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2016 Sixth International Conference on Instrumentation & Measurement, Computer, Communication and Control (IMCCC)
abstract: In this paper, we concentrate on introducing an optimized energy detection approach applied to cognitive MIMO. Firstly, the system with multiple secondary users is modeled and then the weighting factor of each secondary user is calculated and analyzed. Under the constraint that the quadratic sum of combination factors is unit, the optimal weighting factors of secondary users sharing some certain spectrum resource are derived by calculating the first and second order derivative from expression of the received Signal-to-Noise Ratio. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can have better performance than the traditional schemes, such as MRC (Maximum Ratio Combining) or EGC (Equal Gain Combining).
